data.name: Recognize Pattern
data.description: You can recognize and prepare against the same behavior from creatures. Any time you are subjected to the same effect or combat maneuver by the same creature, you gain +%1 bonus against that effect's saving throw (if any) or to your CMD. The effect or combat maneuver must have been previously used against you within %2 rounds.|RecognizePatternBonus|RecognizePatternDuration
